name: azurepr
description: Interactively create pull requests with required reviewers on Azure DevOps Server / TFS (and Azure DevOps Services) repos.

server_url.title: Azure DevOps server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Azure DevOps Server / TFS, e.g. https://devops.example.com/tfs (or https://dev.azure.com/your-org). PRs are only created for git remotes under this URL. Leave empty to accept any remote containing /_git/.

default_target_branch.title: Default target branch
default_target_branch.description: Branch suggested first as the PR target, e.g. main, develop or stage.

api_version.title: REST API version
api_version.description: Azure DevOps REST api-version. 5.0 works on Azure DevOps Server 2019 and newer; use 6.0 / 7.0 for newer servers or Azure DevOps Services.

styleguide_url.title: Style guide URL (optional)
styleguide_url.description: If set, the PR description checklist includes 'I have read the StyleGuide' linking here. Leave empty to omit that line.

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: 'integrated' = Windows integrated auth / Kerberos (no token, domain-joined machines). 'pat' = Personal Access Token read from the environment variable below.

pat_env_var.title: PAT environment variable
pat_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding your Personal Access Token (scope: Code read & write). Only used when auth mode is 'pat'. The token itself is never stored by the plugin.
